body:
[blocker] Preserve ID-only document deletion

Clients that send only `doc_ids` now receive a server error instead of deleting their documents. When `doc_names` is absent or has no matches, `get_doc_ids_by_doc_names()` returns `None`, and the membership test on the following lines raises `TypeError` before any explicit ID can be appended; the existing web caller in `web/src/hooks/document-hooks.ts:419-423` uses exactly this ID-only request shape. The merged identifier collection must remain iterable when no names resolve so both supported identifier forms continue to work independently.

_P1 · confidence 0.99 · lens pass-baseline, pass-placement, pass-simplicity, pass-backcompat_

[blocker] Scope bulk name resolution to the authenticated tenant

A tenant can delete other tenants’ documents merely by requesting a shared filename. `Document.name` is not globally unique, but this new query returns every matching ID without a tenant predicate; `document_rm()` then replaces the caller’s tenant with each matched document’s owner and removes that document’s database, search-index, file-link, and storage state. Every document selected for deletion must be authorized against the API token’s tenant before any destructive work begins.

_P0 · confidence 0.99 · lens pass-security, pass-baseline, pass-simplicity, pass-backcompat_

[nit] Fetch obsolete canvas-version IDs in one query

Please select the obsolete IDs in one query before calling `delete_by_ids`. Indexing this lazy Peewee query once per version still performs a separate offset lookup for every obsolete row, so the cleanup path retains the linear database reads this change is intended to remove.

_P3 · confidence 0.95 · lens pass-simplicity, pass-baseline, pass-intent_

[nit] Batch the remaining tenant lookups

Please include tenant information in this batch query, or fetch it with one bulk join. The loop still calls `DocumentService.get_tenant_id()` once per document at line 646, so this optimized path continues to issue linear database reads.

_P3 · confidence 0.92 · lens pass-intent_
